mapper.select: SELECT s.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_messages m WHERE m.session_id = s.id) AS message_count FROM customer_sessions s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_sessions (id, user_id, title, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{userId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{title}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
